applies_to: sensor_collection_box / relay_control_box QT Py ESP32-S3 sensor half (docs/hardware/esphome/box2-bench.yaml)
source_of_truth: box2-bench.yaml; this file mirrors it for docs and the other boxes
evaluation: re-evaluated every 1 s; first matching state in priority order wins

states.meaning: Wi-Fi up, no Home Assistant API client connected yet
states.when: Wi-Fi connected and API client not connected

states.meaning: SEN66 or SHT45 failed, or no temperature reading after 120 s
states.when: sensor component failed, or uptime > 120 s and a temperature is NaN

states.meaning: Wi-Fi up, HA connected, both sensors reporting

notes: On a bench with no HA client the light shows purple blink, not rainbow.
Check the colours through the acrylic light pipe; amber at 15 % brightness reads as orange.
